chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Salih ibn Uqba, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Ju'fi and Uqba, both together, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Verily, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created the creation. So He created those whom He loved from what He loved, and what He loved was that He created it from the clay of Paradise; and He created those whom He hated from what He hated, and what He hated was that He created it from the clay of the Fire. Then He sent them into the shadows.
So I asked: 'And what are the shadows?' He said: 'Have you not seen your shadow in the sun — it is something, yet it is not a thing?'
Then He sent Prophets from among them, and they invited them to the acknowledgment of Allah, Mighty and Majestic — and that is His word, Mighty and Majestic:
"And if you ask them who created them, they would certainly say: Allah." [43:87]

Then they invited them to the acknowledgment of the Prophets; some acknowledged and some denied. Then they invited them to our Wilayah, and, by God, the one who loved acknowledged it, and the one who hated denied it. And that is His word:
"But they were not going to believe in what they had belied before." [10:74]
Then Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'The denial was there (at that time).'

key_terms.التَّكْذِيبُ: The denial/belying — the pre-eternal rejection of Wilayah by those created from the clay of Fire
key_terms.الظِّلَال: The shadows/realm of shadows ('alam al-zill) — a pre-physical intermediate realm where souls existed in shadow form before entering the physical world
key_terms.الْإِقْرَار: Acknowledgment/recognition — the formal acceptance of God's sovereignty, Prophethood, and Imamate
key_terms.طِينَةُ النَّارِ: Clay of Fire — the primordial substance from which despised souls were formed
key_terms.طِينَةُ الْجَنَّةِ: Clay of Paradise — the primordial substance from which beloved souls were formed
key_terms.وَلَايَتِنَا: Our Wilayah — the divinely ordained authority and guardianship of the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir say about the creation of souls from the clay of Paradise and Fire in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) narrates a cosmological teaching about the pre-eternal differentiation of souls: those beloved by God were created from the clay of Paradise, while those despised were created from the clay of Fire. God then sent them into the realm of shadows ('alam al-zill) — the pre-physical world of forms — and thereafter raised Prophets to invite them to acknowledge God, the Prophets, and ultimately the Wilayah (divinely appointed guardianship) of the Ahl al-Bayt. The hadith anchors the Shia doctrine of divine predetermination in a primordial covenant, explaining that those who reject Wilayah in this life had already rejected it in the pre-existential realm — their denial is thus a continuation of ancient opposition rooted in the nature of their clay.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Salih Bin Uqba, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Juf’y, and Uqba altogether, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Created the creatures.

So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the ones He<sup>azwj</sup> Loved from what He<sup>azwj</sup> Loved, and whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> Loved He<sup>azwj</sup>, Created it from the clay of the Paradise; and He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the ones He<sup>azwj</sup> Hated from what He<sup>azwj</sup> Hated, and whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> Hated, Created it from the clay of the Fire. Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Sent them into the shadows’.
So I said, ‘And which thing is the shadow?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do you not see your own shadow in the sunshine? It is something, but is not a thing’.

Then Heazwj Sent Prophetsas from them, and theyas invited them to the acknowledgment in Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, and these are the Words of the Mighty and Majestic [43:87] And if you should ask them who created them, they would certainly say: Allah. Then Heazwj Invited them to the acknowledgement in the Prophetsas.

So some of them acknowledged, and some denied. Then Heazwj Invited them to ourasws Wilayah, So he acknowledge in it, By Allahazwj, the one whom Heazwj Loved, and he denied it, the one whom Heazwj Hated, and these are Hisazwj Words [10:74] but they were not going to believe in what they had belied in beforehand’.
Then Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The belying (in us<sup>asws</sup>) was (from) then’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il from Salih ibn ‘Aqaba from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad al-Ju’fi and ‘Aqaba together from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, created the creation. He created His most beloved ones from that which He loved most. What was most beloved to Him was the fact that he created His most beloved ones from the clay of paradise. He created those whom He hated most from that which he hated most. What was most hated to Him was the fact that he created from the clay of the fire and then sent them to the shadows.
I asked him, ‘What are the shadows?’ He replied, ‘Have you not seen your own shadow in a sunny day that looks like a thing but is nothing?
Allah then raised from them the prophets who called them to believe in Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, as mentioned in His, words,
“When you ask them who has created them they will say, ‘Allah.” [31:25]

He then called them to express their belief in the prophets. Some expressed their belief as such and others among them did not do so. He then called them to express their (Wala’) belief and support to us (A hi al-Bayt). I swear by Allah, those whom He loved expressed their belief that we were the people who possess Divine Authority and only those whom He hated refused to express such beliefs as it is said in the following verse of the Holy Quran.
“They do not express faith in what they before had refused to have faith in.’” [7:101]
Abu Ja’far (a.s.) then said, ‘Rejection (to have faith in us) was then.’”
